Store projected costs for Pulumi stack checkpoints

## Synopsis

```text
Collect projected costs from Pulumi checkpoints. Terraform directories are unsupported because plans have no checkpoint list; run cost projected to record Terraform projections instead.
```

```text
finfocus cost history collect [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  finfocus cost history collect --stack dev
  finfocus cost history collect --stack dev --versions 20
  finfocus cost history collect --stack dev --from 2025-01-01 --skip-destroy
```

## Options

```text
      --from string                 Only collect versions on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  -h, --help[=true|false]           help for collect
      --parallel int                Concurrent pulumi stack exports (default 4)
      --skip-destroy[=true|false]   Skip destroy versions instead of storing them as $0
      --versions int                Limit to the last N versions (0 = all)
```
